base: Read ARTSTYLE.md and the attached relevant original PNG references. Produce ONE candidate asset in detailed stepped arcade pixel art, navy/cyan/violet with restrained magenta and a consistent top-left keylight. Use genuine alpha transparency outside the subject, no labels, checkerboard, UI, people, replacement logos, photographic noise or blurred base shading. Preserve the specified stage perspective, fixed anchors and declared pixel grid. Keep unlit art and physical shadows separate from emission. Return actual dimensions and any unmet requirements; do not claim pixel-exact timing or loops without inspection.
